items.DR_Harbinger_Scythe.name: Harbinger of the Pale Rider
items.DR_Harbinger_Scythe.description:
A crescent of blackened mithril carries the skulls of those who bargained with the last Horseman. Their silent mouths drink the final warmth from every wound and return it as power to the hand that reaps. Death does not hurry. His tithe always comes due.

Primary: alternating 3.5-block soul sweeps; 84 Physical base damage with a 0.52-second base swing cycle, +1.5 Mana and +1 signature charge on hit. Secondary: stamina guard. Q - The Final Tithe: spend all 12 charges and 12 Mana for a committed heavy sweep dealing 370 Physical base damage with a 1.01-second windup and 1.4-second total action; steals 8 Health from every enemy hit with no multi-target falloff. Also restores Mana on hit (8 initially, reduced for additional targets). Lifesteal cannot exceed maximum Health. Native resistances, parries and skill scaling apply.
